style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Prelit Faux Nordic Spruce Hinged 7ft Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: This 7ft pre-lit faux Nordic spruce delivers a full, realistic tree shape with 2,786 branch tips and a classic conical silhouette – built to be the centrepiece of your Christmas room year after year. The PE and PVC branch blend replicates the look and feel of a genuine Nordic spruce, with varied branch lengths and tonal greens that give it the natural layering of a real tree. 460 warm white LEDs are pre-woven throughout the branches and come with 8 multifunction lighting modes – including static, twinkling, fading, and chasing sequences – so you can set the mood exactly how you want it from a single controller. No additional lights required. Hinged branches make assembly straightforward: connect the three sections, fan out the branches by hand, and the tree takes shape in minutes. The UKCA-certified plug-in power source has a 182cm cable – long enough to reach a socket without the wire being on show. Ideal for: Living rooms, dining rooms, hallways, and any space where a full-sized, realistic-looking Christmas tree is the focal point. .PRE-LIT WITH 460 LED LIGHTS: The Charles Bentley 7ft Pre-lit Christmas Tree is adorned with 460 warm white LED lights, providing a soft and inviting glow that enhances your festive décor and eliminates the need for additional lighting. .EASY ASSEMBLY WITH HINGED BRANCHES: Featuring innovative hinged branches, this tree allows for effortless assembly; simply connect the sections together and watch the branches fall into place, making setup a breeze. .REALISTIC FAUX BRANCHES: Crafted from a premium mixture of specially designed PE and PVC materials, this tree captures the appearance of a natural Nordic spruce, delivering a stunningly realistic look that brings the beauty indoors. .FULLER APPEARANCE WITH 2,700 BRANCH TIPS: With an impressive 2,700 branch tips, this tree provides a fuller and more luxurious appearance, ensuring ample space for your favourite ornaments and decorations. .IDEAL HEIGHT FOR ANY SPACE: Standing at 7 feet tall, this conical-shaped tree is perfect for any living room, dining room, or hallway, making it an eye-catching centrepiece for your holiday celebrations. ADDITIONAL INFO: The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look. Power source: electric, UKCA plug, Cable length from plug to base of tree: 182cm. DIMENSIONS: Height: 7ft, Girth: 55 inches. For indoor use only Dimensions(mm): Height: 2140 Width: 1400 Depth: 1400 UK Mainland Delivery Only.
